reviews.text: Can’t recommend them enough. All people there were great to deal with Mark went above and beyond won’t use anybody but them

reviews.author: Benjamin Shamel
reviews.text: Great experience with Mark (or perhaps Mike? The truck was loud and I didn't exactly get his name, I do apologize)! Professional, quick, and friendly. I would highly recommend this business to anyone who needs a tow in the Metrolina area! Thank y'all for helping me out, I appreciate it.

reviews.author: Charlene Hall
reviews.text: Can’t say enough about the gentleman who came as soon as we called!! If it hadn’t been for his great service we would have missed our opportunity at an emergency repair and been stranded on a Saturday 330 miles from our destination!! I wish I got your name but thanks for being so professional and kind even to our Frenchie!!! I would highly recommend this towing company to anyone who needs one.

reviews.author: Leo Silvia
reviews.text: These guys literally saved the day!!! My 13k pound Isuzu truck's back tires fell into a sink/septic hole. It was 5:30pm on a Friday and I honestly didn't think we'd be able to get it out without an actual crane which, because of the weekend, probably wouldn't have happened for days. The first guy showed up within 20 minutes but wasn't able to get it out on his own. He then called in reinforcments and went and got a Bobcat. The All American Towing team did a GREAT JOB getting it out and the truck wasn't damaged at all. On top of actually accomplishing what I thought was an impossible feet they did so at a reasonable price and they both had great personalities which helped during an incredibly stressful situation. I highly recommend them. They were AMAZING!

reviews.author: Jake Helms
reviews.text: Mark and the guys do all of our towing at our mechanic shop. They are fast, friendly, affordable, and very professional! They have very nice trucks as well! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Taylor Moore
reviews.text: All American is a great hometown towing company with good employees. They are serious about getting to your Tows as fast as possible. Will definitely use them again in future towing needs.

reviews.author: Josh Thomas
reviews.text: These guys are honest and fair. My girlfriend was in wreck and they got here car. They have been very patient and helpful health with this. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Paul Williams
reviews.text: I work at Mooresville Ford and we called Mark to pick up a vehicle because the key stopped working. It was in the mid 90’s and there was an entire family stranded because of this. Before he would leave them Mark called and made sure I came with our shuttle van to pick them up. Good guy as well as good service.

reviews.author: Tom Norton
reviews.text: Needed my daughter’s non-running car towed from her house in Mooresville to my house in Statesville so I could take a look at what the problem was. Mark answered the phone, was courteous, said he could pick the car up in an hour or so, and gave a fair quote. I gave him instructions on where the car was, and where the key was, as my daughter was not home at the time. The car showed up in my driveway on the truck a short time later. The tow truck was clean and looked to be well maintained. Mark unloaded the car at my house in the location I asked. Mark was professional and friendly. Good service.

reviews.author: jim diers
reviews.text: I needed to have a car towed to a dealer and needed it fairly quickly. I received fast, professional, personal service with great care for the car. The entire experience was very impressive and I would highly recommend using All American towing!

reviews.author: Don Rodger
reviews.text: Was on vacation in Troutman, trail riding in Lake Norman for a few days, when my truck battery died. I called two places, one of them being All American Towing. The gentlemen showed up in 10-minutes and had my truck started quickly. Very friendly. I offered him more money than he quoted on the phone because I was expecting to wait for an hour or two. He wouldn't accept it. He settled for the agreed upon fee and a hand shake. We need more of these guys in the World. Thank you for your assistance, Sir!

reviews.author: Debra Sievers
reviews.text: These guys are amazing. They helped my son after his car wreck last weekend. They helped my son get his car off the road safely and fixes it in a timely manor.

reviews.author: Phillip Davis
reviews.text: Used this service thru AAA Motor Club. On the scene within 25 minutes of reporting car breakdown. Technican was very professional and courteous.

reviews.author: Roger
reviews.text: Lockout service saved the day on a recent trip to Devaste Winery. Fast, professional service. 5 stars!
